  • At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Champlain.

Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 6–12 credits per university semester is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • Uses the $342 standard rate. Reduced rates ($297 for alumni, associate-degree graduates, veterans and military families; $250 for servicemembers; truED employer rates) are not applied.
  • The fee-details page’s cost-of-attendance example still multiplies by $335; the current tuition page lists $342 for Fall 2026–Summer 2027.
  • Books for the few courses that require them are not included.
  • 6–12 credits per semester is a planning assumption.
  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.
  • 42 proposed outside units retain the eligibility conditions shown on their course rows.

Questions

Does Sophia Introduction to Information Technology transfer to Champlain College Online?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Introduction to Information Technology for General Electives (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Champlain, so ask Champlain to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Personal Finance transfer to Champlain College Online?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Personal Finance for General Electives (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Champlain, so ask Champlain to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Introduction to Nutrition transfer to Champlain College Online?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Introduction to Nutrition for General Electives (3 semester credits). The match does not come from Champlain, so ask Champlain to confirm it before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Champlain College Online’s Bachelor of Arts in Applied Psychology?

Champlain’s published limit for this 120-credit degree is 90 semester credits from other sources. At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Champlain. This plan proposes 42 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Champlain College Online?

In this plan, 78 semester credits are taken at Champlain, including PSYC 100 Psychology, Introduction to, PSYC 230 Developmental Psychology, PSYC 250 Social Psychology, PSYC 270 Cognitive Psyc, PSYC 350 Psych Disorders and PSYC 360 Psychology of Personality and 9 more. Champlain requires at least 30 semester credits at Champlain.

Can I choose my own courses in this plan?

Yes. 33 semester credits are open choices, such as Applied Advanced Electives: two 400-level PSYC courses (PSYC 410, PSYC 440, or PSYC 455), Applied Advanced Electives: two 200+ level CRIM or SOCI courses and General Electives. You pick a course Champlain allows, then ask Champlain to confirm it counts.

How much does this plan cost?

The planning estimate is $27,125 to $27,422 before aid. It covers tuition, listed fees and the outside courses in this plan. It is not a complete cost of attendance.

Has Champlain College Online confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Champlain’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Ask the school: what is the most ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit you accept toward this degree? Ask the school to confirm 5 proposed course matches for this exact program before paying for them. Pick a course for 11 open course choices in this plan, then ask the school to confirm they count. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Champlain’s decisions.
